successCriteria.description: The Jest suite in tests/unit/shared/date.test.ts asserts exact UTC timestamps (via getTime()) for startOfUtcDay, addMonths, and periodContaining across normal, boundary, and month-end-clamping cases, and the full suite passes under `npx jest`.

The non-UTC timezone block sets process.env.TZ to a non-UTC zone (e.g. 'Asia/Riyadh') and constructs at least one input using local-time Date construction (e.g. `new Date(2023, 5, 15, 14, 30, 45, 123)`) so the test would fail if the helpers used local getFullYear/getMonth/getDate instead of UTC accessors; it restores the original TZ in afterAll.

addMonths month-end clamping is covered for: 31-day to 30-day month, 31-day to non-leap February (28), 31-day to leap-year February (29), and negative offsets that clamp backward (e.g. Mar 31 -> Feb 28).

periodContaining is covered for: date equal to anchor start (inclusive), date equal to period end (exclusive, rolls to next period), multi-month accrual periods, a date several periods ahead, anchor-day-exceeds-target-month clamping, and the ConflictError thrown when date precedes anchor and when the period cannot be resolved (accrualMonths <= 0).

Any flagged/incorrect assertion line in the existing test file is corrected so that every assertion reflects the actual semantics of src/shared/date/accrual.ts (e.g. the ConflictError message 'Requested date precedes the accrual anchor' and statusCode 409 / code 'CONFLICT'), with no test asserting behavior the implementation does not provide.

constraints: Do not modify src/shared/date/accrual.ts, src/shared/date/index.ts, or src/shared/errors/index.ts — this phase only updates tests/unit/shared/date.test.ts (and corrects flagged lines within it).
Tests must assert exact UTC instants via getTime()/Date.UTC comparisons, not locale-formatted strings or local getters, so results are timezone-independent.
The non-UTC timezone block must save and restore process.env.TZ (beforeAll/afterAll) so no test leaks a mutated TZ into sibling suites.
Tests must not mutate their Date inputs; where non-mutation is asserted, capture the input's getTime() before the call and compare after.
outOfScope: Refactoring src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts or src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts to import the shared date helpers (deferred to a later phase per PLAN.md).
Changing the behavior or signatures of startOfUtcDay, addMonths, or periodContaining — semantics are copied verbatim and must not be altered.
Adding integration/e2e tests or touching the EmployeeProfile / LeaveRequestQueryParams shared-type changes from Phase 1.

ambiguities.description: Whether the non-UTC timezone block should use local-time Date construction (new Date(y, m, d, ...)) to genuinely exercise timezone sensitivity, or keep Date.UTC inputs (which would not actually test the timezone independence).
options: Use local-time construction for at least one input so the test is meaningful
Keep Date.UTC inputs and only assert TZ is set

ambiguities.description: Which specific line(s) the review flagged as incorrect — the intent says 'correct any flagged line' but does not identify them; the code agent must infer from the implementation semantics.
options: The ConflictError message assertion ('Unable to resolve accrual period' vs actual 'Requested date precedes the accrual anchor')
A clamping expectation that mismatches addMonths behavior
No flagged line exists; only coverage gaps remain

entityInvariants.invariant: Returns a new Date at UTC midnight of the input's UTC calendar day (UTC hours/minutes/seconds/milliseconds all 0) and never mutates its input; the result is independent of the process timezone.

Returns a new Date advanced by the given integer month offset, clamping the day-of-month to the last day of the target month (including leap-year February), supports negative offsets, and never mutates its input; arithmetic is UTC-based and timezone-independent.

Returns { start, end } where start is the UTC day start of the anchor and end is start advanced by accrualMonths (clamped); the period is half-open [start, end); throws ConflictError when date < anchor or when the period cannot be resolved within the 10,000-iteration bound.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Test expectations must match the exact semantics of the exported helpers (UTC accessors, half-open period, 10,000-iteration bound, ConflictError messages 'Requested date precedes the accrual anchor' and 'Unable to resolve accrual period').
ConflictError assertions must match the shared error contract: instanceof ConflictError, statusCode 409, code 'CONFLICT'.
Imports must use the public re-export surface (startOfUtcDay, addMonths, periodContaining) rather than deep-importing the accrual module.
